note:
The 1911 household at 1 Park Terrace.

**Two of the three are bound by number** - Mary Patterson (#3584) and Emma Jarvis (#3585) - so no second person is created whatever the spelling, and each carries their name as well because the importer skips a record without one.

**The rename is not here and cannot be.** The record holds Mary ELY Patterson and the return says Elizabeth; an import never renames anybody, so that is a job on her own page.

**Emma Jarvis is bound to #3585, not #4757.** She is in the record twice - see the transcription file - and #3585 is the one this return's age agrees with.

**Mary Saxby is deliberately not in this file.** She is a servant at 3 Park Terrace on this return at 45, and the record holds two Mary Saxbys at that house - #4760 born 1856 and #1797 born 1861 - with three birthplaces between them and her age recorded as 45 in 1901 as well as here. Importing her would make a third. She wants settling on the site first.

**Frances Mary Wing goes in as a new person, not bound to #1790 Frances May King**, for the same reason: the two are very probably one woman, but joining them is a merge and a merge is not an import's to make.
source: 1911 census household schedule, 1 Park Terrace - read from the index supplied by A. Hagues
